task_description: Build an additive, WordPress-style custom admin editor at /admin for Coinscribed (Next.js 14 + Sanity). It authenticates each writer with their OWN Sanity account (multi-user, Editor/Admin roles managed in manage.sanity.io) and writes back into the SAME Sanity dataset AS THE LOGGED-IN USER (no master write token). Core deliverables: protected /admin dashboard + Studio-like shell; full article editor (title, auto slug, excerpt, author/category pickers, publishedAt, SEO title<=70/description<=160, FAQs); a rich-text body editor emitting valid Portable Text matching data/sample-news.ts + PortableTextRenderer.tsx; featured + inline image upload to Sanity assets as the user; and THE headline feature - an easy spreadsheet-style visual TABLE editor that serializes to the existing tableBlock shape (caption?, header:string[], rows:[{_type:'row',cells:string[]}]) so tables render identically and stay Studio-editable; plus Draft/Publish via the drafts.<id> convention. /studio and the public site remain untouched.

verification.summary: Local build/lint/tsc CANNOT run in this sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: npm registry unreachable; node_modules incomplete, no next/tsc/eslint binaries, @sanity/client package folder empty). Authoritative next build + next lint is deferred to GitHub Actions CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml runs npm ci && npm run build && npm run lint on push). Verified by static review + git diff. All 4 features completed; 3 semantic review passes run (v1/v2/v3) with fixes applied after each. Final commits: 3fb2a56, 1096c7c, e0ee943, 564d681, 114c70a (v1 fixes: per-user token auth flow, CORS diagnostics, rich-text normalization), 07d66f9 (v2 fix: inline body image renderer handler), b200743 (v3 fix: type-safe urlFor call for strict mode). Verified: (1) diff vs main is purely additive - the only touched previously-protected file is components/news/PortableTextRenderer.tsx and ONLY to ADD a types.image handler (45+13 insertions, existing tableBlock/block/mark/list handlers byte-for-byte unchanged); app/studio/*, sanity.config.ts, sanity/schemas/*, lib/sanity.ts, lib/sanity-queries.ts UNCHANGED, so Studio + public rendering unaffected; (2) NO master/write token anywhere - all reads/writes/uploads run as the logged-in Sanity USER via getAdminClient() (per-user session token via withConfig({token}) captured from the ?type=token hosted-login return, plus withCredentials fallback); (3) table editor serializes to the exact tableBlock shape {_type:'tableBlock',caption?,header,rows:[{_type:'row',cells}]}; article/body/faq/reference/image shapes match sanity/schemas/article.ts; (4) inline body images now render publicly + in Studio via the new image handler; (5) zero new npm dependencies; no test framework in project (test_quality n/a). REMAINING UNVERIFIABLE-OFFLINE ITEM (non-blocking, documented for user): the Sanity ?type=token hosted-login return param name (sid vs token, both handled) needs a real-browser smoke test. v3 review verdict was NEEDS_CHANGES solely for the urlFor strict-mode type issue, which was then fixed in b200743 (constructs a fully-typed SanityImageSource); review budget (3 passes) reached.
